_comment1: IMPORTANT: Replace the values below with your own Discord server IDs
_comment2: Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings > App Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode)
_comment3: Right-click on a channel and select 'Copy ID' to get the channel ID
_comment4: Right-click on a role in the server settings and select 'Copy ID' to get the role ID
_comment5: suggestionChannelId: The channel where users will send their suggestions
_comment6: approverRoleId: The role that can approve/reject suggestions
_comment7: logChannelId: The channel where suggestion actions will be logged
